priority_definitions.high_retention: No separate15% high preservation pool; full60% uniform retains all legal103k support. High-cohort outcomes require independent diagnostics.
priority_definitions.missing_stale_capped: Fallback to uniform, count actual fallback. No fabricated scores/teacher/A; no silent missing-scene exclusion.
priority_definitions.nominal_hard: Current own TRAIN canonical B1 score<.9
priority_definitions.regression: Own best-score drop>=.05 OR ever strict NC=DAC=TTC1 now any fails OR previous own score>=.9 now<.9; separate15% quota from25%hard
priority_definitions.same_token_in_both: May be eligible for both pools but never duplicated within a valid globalB and shared epochpriority cap4 applies
priority_definitions.uniform: Source torch.randperm seed42+sourceEpoch with independent cursor; priority and padding NEVER advance uniform cursor

runtime_mask_requirements: Padding still produces real candidate/scorer queries if runtime elects so; count these as physical queries, never valid scene exposures.
